record.hypothesis: Across all four categories, construct the causal feature log1p(training_count[item]) minus its cumulative mean over the observed prefix; project this scalar into historical inputs, with padding zero. Within each existing NextItNet block, replace the residual update with residual+sigmoid(W*norm(residual)+b)*y, using a jointly trained channel gate initialized with b=2. Relative frequency highlights shifts between common and niche items, while gates allow context-dependent convolution updates rather than uniformly halving residuals, which regressed. Preserve all existing hyperparameters, embeddings, scoring, readout and pointwise loss. Save training-count buffers and update the predictor writer; retain one checkpoint/category and fixed seeds and caps.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four categories, project training log-frequency relative to its observed-prefix mean into historical inputs. Mask padding and checkpoint the frequency buffer. Preserve candidate embeddings, scoring, loss and training settings; update the predictor writer to restore the same feature configuration.

Retain every NextItNet causal convolution and add a jointly trained channel gate to each residual update. Gates use the normalized current-position residual, with zero weights and bias 2 initially, allowing context-dependent updates within each category's single model. The predictor imports this same architecture.
